body.sourceEnglish:
Zones and sectors help you cut wasted labour. Zones run 0 to 5 by how often you visit. Zone 0 is the house. In this example, Zone 1 is near the house and holds what you pick often — herbs, salad greens. Zone 2 is the main garden and chicken run, visited once or twice a day. Zone 3 is the main field, visited weekly. Zone 4 is semi-wild — fruit trees and fodder needing occasional attention. Zone 5 is left wild.

Sectors are the energies arriving from outside — sun, wind, rain, flood, fire. Watch where strong wind comes from on your farm. Nearby weather-station records can help you check wind direction. Watch where rainwater enters and flows across your land. Draw arrows for what you observe.

Sketch zones and sectors on paper and you have the skeleton of your design.
body.draft:
Zones na sectors zwi thusa u fhungudza mushumo u sa ṱoḓei. Zones dzi bva kha 0 u ya kha 5, zwi tshi tevhedza uri ni dalela fhethu honoho lunzhi-lini. Zone 0 ndi nnḓu. Kha tsumbo iyi, Zone 1 i tsini na nnḓu nahone i na zwine na zwi ka lunzhi — herbs na muroho wa saladi. Zone 2 ndi serapa tshihulwane na chicken run, zwine zwa dalelwa luthihi kana luvhili nga ḓuvha. Zone 3 ndi tsimu khulwane, ine ya dalelwa vhege iṅwe na iṅwe. Zone 4 ndi semi-wild — miri ya mitshelo na fodder zwine zwa ṱoḓa ṱhogomelo nga zwiṅwe zwifhinga. Zone 5 yo siwa i wild.

Sectors ndi energy dzi no swika dzi tshi bva nnḓa — ḓuvha, muya, mvula, mandindi na mulilo. Sedzani hune muya u re na maanḓa wa bva hone bulasini yaṋu. Rekhodo dza weather station ya tsini dzi nga thusa u sedza thungo ya muya. Sedzani hune maḓi a mvula a dzhena hone na hune a elela hone kha land yaṋu. Olani misevhe u sumbedza zwe na zwi vhona.

Olani zones na sectors kha bammbiri, nahone ni vha ni na motheo wa pulane yaṋu.

question.sourceEnglish: You plant herbs in Zone 3, the main field far from the house. What problem does this create?
question.draft: Ni ṱavha herbs kha Zone 3, tsimu khulwane i re kule na nnḓu. Hezwi zwi vhanga thaidzo-ḓe?

options.draft: Herbs dzi aluwa zwihulwane lwo kalaho

options.sourceEnglish: The extra walk may mean you pick or check them less often
options.draft: Lwendo lwo engedzeaho lu nga amba uri ni nga ka kana u sedza herbs less often
Herbs dzi cross-pollinate na zwimela zwihulwane

options.sourceEnglish: Zone 3 gets too much sun for herbs
options.draft: Zone 3 i wana ḓuvha ḽinzhi lwo kalaho kha herbs

rationale.sourceEnglish: Put a crop you pick often near a daily path. A distant bed adds walking and may be checked less often.
rationale.draft: Vheani tshimela tshine na tshi ka lunzhi tsini ha nḓila ya ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe. Bed i re kule i engedza u tshimbila nahone i nga tolwa less often.

question.sourceEnglish: You observe damaging wind coming from the north-west on a Highveld farm. Where should a windbreak go?
question.draft: Musi ni tshi vhona “damaging wind coming from the north-west on a Highveld farm”, windbreak i fanela u vhewa ngafhi?

options.sourceEnglish: North-west boundary, between the wind and the crops
options.draft: Moedi wa North-west, vhukati ha muya na zwimela

options.sourceEnglish: Windbreaks aren't needed since winds are seasonal
options.draft: Windbreaks a dzi ṱoḓei ngauri mimuya i ya nga khalaṅwaha

rationale.sourceEnglish: A windbreak works by standing between the wind source and what it would damage — so it belongs on the side the wind actually comes from.
rationale.draft: Windbreak i shuma nga u ima vhukati ha hune muya wa bva hone na tshine ya nga tshi tshinya — ngauralo i fanela u vha kha sia ḽine muya wa bva khaḽo zwa vhukuma.

uncertainties: The precise local-language rendering of energy-sector terminology and fodder is uncertain; those technical terms remain in English. Zone and sector names are retained as formal labels.

The conditional source phrase “damaging wind coming from the north-west on a Highveld farm” remains exact English in the question. The answer is limited to the direction of the observed damaging wind.
The proposals retain the formal English term herbs pending confirmation of its local equivalent.
The simple sketch key point retains design to avoid implying construction.
review: Independently backchecked source alignment, zone order/frequencies, conditional observed wind direction, quiz answers, and the supplemental herbs/design wording. Unreviewed machine draft; no fluent Tshivenda or local farming approval is claimed.

keyPoints.sourceEnglish: In this example, Zone 1 near the house holds often-picked herbs
keyPoints.draft: Kha tsumbo iyi, Zone 1 i re tsini na nnḓu i na herbs dzine na dzi ka lunzhi.

keyPoints.sourceEnglish: A simple sketch of zones and sectors is enough to start designing
keyPoints.draft: Nyolo yo leluwaho ya zones na sectors yo lingana u thoma design.
